abstract: The proposed dissolution of Weil, Gotshal & Manges followed an exodus of prominent partners from one of America’s largest law firms. Its rapid decline illustrates how departures by key employees can encourage others to leave, even when a firm remains profitable. This column explains why such departures can become self-reinforcing and how firms can mitigate the problem through compensation design. Deferred fixed pay, dilutable compensation, and different compensation structures across employees can help firms retain skilled teams at lower cost.
title: Worker runs: How compensation design can curb contagious departures like that at Weil, Gotschal & Manges

abstract: Central banks use the interest rate paid on reserves as their key monetary policy instrument. This column argues that monetary policy creates an important cycle in banks’ profitability. Since 2021, return on equity and net interest income in euro area banks have increased, following higher interest rates and the previous quantitative easing programme. The counterpart to this development is large losses at central banks and a burden on taxpayers in the Eurosystem. To deal with this, it suggests central banks increase the unremunerated minimum reserves or to consider a tax on banks’ excess profits.
title: The return of inflation: More bank profits, more central bank losses

abstract: “高水平科技自立自强”和“现代化产业体系”是构建中国经济学自主知识体系的标识性概念，也是习近平经济思想理论体系中重要的科学范畴。高水平科技自立自强能够通过自主技术供给、转型升级驱动、产业生态构建、产业安全保障、本土市场主导和创新人才支撑等作用机制驱动现代化产业体系建设；在经济高质量发展实践中，高水平科技自立自强能够通过提升产业体系的完整性、先进性和安全性加快产业体系现代化进程，通过推动产业体系智能化、绿色化和融合化提升现代化产业体系的发展水平和国际竞争力。以高水平科技自立自强引领和驱动现代化产业体系建设的政策重点是树立服务国家战略的体系化发展理念、超前谋划科技创新和产业布局，加快新型基础设施建设、推动应用融合与场景赋能，强化新型要素引领和支撑、培育和发展新质生产力，夯实基础研究的源头自主供给、推动关键核心技术突破，深化科技体制机制改革、构建和优化科技和产业的创新生态。

abstract: 在中美科技博弈与全球保护主义加剧的背景下，中国面临日益严峻的技术脱钩压力与创新挑战。随着研发门槛持续上升，高技术研发越来越依赖于在该领域中拥有卓越实力的领军企业。本文以超级明星创新企业为切入点，发现中国的专利集中度呈现与美国不同的“先上升、后下降”的动态变化，揭示了中国技术崛起中的一系列典型事实，由此构建了一个后发国家技术赶超中企业创新行为的动态均衡模型。研究发现，当后发国家的超级明星创新企业实现技术赶超后，将通过打破先发国家企业的市场垄断并释放创新激励，驱使非明星创新企业加大研发投入和创新力度，最终推动后发国家整体实现技术崛起与经济增长。多情境数值模拟表明，对于后发国家而言，定向研发补贴和降低研发要素成本均能推动实现技术赶超，而知识溢出效应发挥着关键性的作用。结合中美两国的对比分析发现，持续增强的知识溢出效应、广延边际的产业创新投资，与超级明星创新企业的技术赶超共同驱动了中国专利集中度的演变与技术崛起。中国的创新驱动发展已进入加快培育超级明星创新企业的阶段，这为我国科技领军企业的定位和布局提供了重要经验证据和理论支撑。

abstract: The Sustainable Development Goals call for women’s full and effective participation in decision-making, yet tools to measure women’s empowerment within policy processes remain limited. This paper develops the Women’s Empowerment in Agrifood Governance (WEAGov) framework—nine indicators, 38 measures, and a scoring method that assess whether women are considered, included, and influential at the design, implementation, and evaluation stages of the agrifood policy cycle—and applies it in India and Nigeria. The pilots combine content analysis of 49 agrifood policies with surveys of 274 public, private, civil society, and research organizations and 407 policy experts. In both countries, gender priorities articulated in policy documents weaken during budgeting, implementation, and evaluation. Women participate as staff and mid-level managers in agrifood organizations, but their representation in senior decision-making roles and their influence over policy decisions remain limited, constrained by social norms and limited awareness of policies and rights. Gender-responsive budgeting is absent in Nigeria and, in India, has become a procedural exercise rather than a driver of resource allocation. The two countries face different bottlenecks: India’s main challenge is converting formal gender commitments into women’s influence within state institutions, whereas Nigeria’s is translating women’s influence through civil society into formal commitments and inclusion mechanisms. Triangulating document reviews with expert assessments exposes gaps between formal commitments and practice that conventional indicators miss. We identify a core set of measures and minimum sampling requirements for rapid, low-cost applications, offering governments, researchers, and civil society a tool to diagnose and monitor gender gaps in agrifood policy processes.
title: Are agrifood policy processes Empowering Women? framework, measurement, and empirical evidence from India and Nigeria
